reviewed_component: Existing EDI v0.9.0 connection to frozen Meadows world

criteria.rationale: Ten derived integration obligations map the handoff and actual C0 requirements to planned cases.
Existing endpoints are distinguished from proposed image/scheduler/action/clock contracts; these must be concrete before execution.
Reuse existing C0–C7; three external execution roles, one student, no extra intelligence layer or authored forest workflow.
Case/world/generated/derived/empirical evidence, unknown formats and source identities remain distinct; no narrative-match success.
Prospective root and per-job limits exist; hardware/processor/per-owner deployment capacities require pinning and neutral fit evidence.
Crash windows and owner reconciliation specified; implement and verify before relying on checkpoint/replay.
Pinned branch code and primary model/engine/container documents support bounded engineering choices.
Fourteen prospective cases distinguish source planning, engineering, pilot usefulness and future scientific comparison.

findings.description: C4 native inference and multimodal context bindings are not implemented; exact model/container/hardware pins remain open.
findings.smallest_correction: Implement bounded gateway/context extension, pin environment and verify neutral real image/model job.

findings.description: C0 fixed workflows and free-text outbox do not yet provide typed dynamic world-operation scheduling.
findings.smallest_correction: Add durable generic scheduler/strict operation intents; retain EDI-selected content and existing owner lanes.

findings.description: C7 research-readonly contract currently rejects broker acquisition/action; no simulated-session dispatch grant exists.
findings.smallest_correction: Version scoped benchmark grant and action adapter behind C7; separate operator adoption.

findings.description: C6 constructed-world temporal correspondence and source eligibility require a concrete profile; simulation cannot be relabeled empirical.
findings.smallest_correction: Freeze year/time mapping and a reviewed simulated-world assessment profile or explicit unscored outcome.

findings.description: Process isolation, finite per-owner capacity and restart/model fit are proposed, unverified deployment properties.
findings.smallest_correction: Implement allowlisted deployment and pass neutral engineering/negative-probe cases before pilot.

changes.description: Recovered actual implementation branch; preserve both source lines and frozen benchmark.
Proposed native gateway, image binding, dynamic scheduling, C7 world authority and C6 simulation correspondence.
Defined isolated deployment, neutral engineering gate, first unguided pilot and honest model/modality limits.

next_step: Implement/review scoped adapters and exact schemas/pins; freeze neutral fixture, then execute only after separate owner direction.
